test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. M sits third to the right of A. M is second to the left of P. Only one person sits between P and S. Q sits to the immediate right of S, and no other person is sitting in the row. What is the total number of people seated in the row?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row facing north.

1) M sits third to the right of A.

2) M is second to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129deea2d2dc50c0fa099edf21ae85772e4f6fbe3f4ec7dbb718c57faf1b7561.png] 

3) Only one person sits between P and S.

4) Q sits to the immediate right of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbeb1b47bb0ece6a924f84dd65e56dc04fe7b1dcc99bc4205b262ac8cab1ccba.png] 

Here, Total '9' people are sitting in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
